sources.excerpt: Diamond Drive – Diamond Pedals Skip to content Made in Canada - Free Canada/US shipping on orders over $150USD/$200CAD - No Tariffs Menu Search 0 Shopping bag Close Back Home Store Retailers About Us Legacy Contact Join Our Team Login Instagram YouTube It Might Just Be The One Diamond Drive Regular price $199.00 Sale price Select Title Default Title Default Title - Sold out - $199.00 Sold out Share Facebook X (Twitter) Pinterest 0 / 0 Drenched in classic Diamond DNA, the next-gen Diamond Drive is built on a foundation of signature drive and EQ soundblocks. Distilling the most desirable and functional elements of the original J-Drive, Blaze and Fireburst pedals, the Diamond Drive combines a warm and wide-ranging overdrive built around a Premium Sound Burr-Brown Op-amp with a dual band, post-gain active EQ. DIPPED IN DIAMOND DNA Drawing inspiration from past Drive, J-Drive and Fireburst designs, the new Diamond Drive combines our classic overdrive platform with our active Baxandall EQ, and might just be the perfect drive pedal. TAILORED FOR ANY OCCASION The Burr-Brown equipped drive section delivers anything from a gritty clean boost to thick, natural asymmetric saturation while the dual-band active Baxandall EQ and selectable Warm High Shelf Filter dial it all in to perfection. THE NEW STANDARD For the modern pedal-user's needs. Space saving design, without any loss of quality. The Diamond Drive package is complete with top-mounted jacks, 9-18VDC operation and relay based true bypass switching. Instruction Sheet Drive_Instructions.pdf Technical Info Input Impedance: > 1 MΩ Output Impedance: < 10 KΩ Switching: Relay True Bypass Power Requirement: 9-18 VDC , negative tip, 2.1 mm barrel jack. Cosmetic flaws or issues related to wear and tear are not covered. The warranty applies only to the original owner of the product and is not transferable. Warranty coverage terminates three years after the owner receives the product. While a product is under warranty, the product will be repaired free of charge. The owner of the product will be responsible for both shipping to and from Diamond Pedals. Warranty coverage will be automatically canceled should the product be tampered with, modified, abused, damaged through misuse, repaired by an unauthorized third party, or damaged through failure to follow the operating instructions. USE OF AN IMPROPER POWER SUPPLY WILL VOID THE WARRANTY Shipping Free Canada & US shipping on all orders $150.00 USD and up. Discounted shipping available worldwide. sources.excerpt: Diamond Drive 2.0 - Thunderbolt Technologies Skip to main content Technology CJ Nelson Harley Ingleby Ben Skinner Kai Sallas Shop Search Search Close Home » Harley Ingleby x Tolhurst » Diamond Drive 2.0 Diamond Drive 2.0 The original Diamond Drive featured a wider nose. The DD2 offers a more balanced plan shape, while maintaining the same rocker and bottom contours. A light teardrop nose concave has been added for enhanced speed control during noseriding. Other changes are subtle, reflecting ongoing testing and refinement. This board is a proven all-rounder and a reliable workhorse that catches waves more easily than any other model in the HI Series.
